setup.title: Setup
setup.intro: Connect Hetzner once – after that everything runs from the dashboard. Cloudflare and CurseForge are optional.
setup.ready: All set. Servers can be created and started.

hetzner.title: Connect Hetzner Cloud
hetzner.step1: Open a project in the <link>Hetzner Console</link> (ideally a separate one just for game servers).
hetzner.step2: Security → API tokens → “Generate API token” with Read & Write permission.
hetzner.step3: Paste the token here. The dashboard creates and registers its SSH key automatically.
hetzner.tokenStored: Token stored – enter a new one to replace it
hetzner.locationHelp: Nuremberg/Falkenstein have the best connectivity within Germany.
hetzner.sshKey: Public SSH key of the dashboard

cloudflare.title: Cloudflare DNS
cloudflare.intro: This gives every server a fixed address like <mono>{host}</mono> that points to the new IP automatically on every start. Without Cloudflare, players connect via the (changing) IP.
cloudflare.step1: Cloudflare → API tokens → “Create token” → template “Edit zone DNS”.
cloudflare.step2: Select the domain under “Zone resources”, create the token and paste it here.

curseforge.title: CurseForge modpacks
curseforge.intro: Modrinth modpacks work right away. CurseForge modpacks need a free API key from the <link>CurseForge Console</link> (API keys).

security.title: Access & security
security.encrypted: Tokens and the SSH key are stored encrypted in the database (key: DASHBOARD_SECRET_KEY or AUTH_SECRET).
security.firewall: Every server gets its own Hetzner firewall that only opens SSH and the game ports.
security.team: You decide who may use the dashboard under <link>Team</link>. New admins are added by Discord ID via <mono>DASHBOARD_ADMIN_DISCORD_IDS</mono>.

overview.startSuccess: The server is starting – this usually takes 2–4 minutes.
overview.hibernateText: The game is stopped cleanly and the VM is deleted. World and settings stay on the storage – only storage costs remain.
